about: A shaded spectrum between two ends with things pinned where they sit along it, each arriving as it is named: positions between two poles, degrees of something, from one extreme to the other.

ends.about: the two ends' names, split by |

positions.about: where each sits, from 0 (first end) to 1 (second end), or percentages

when.about: moments each thing is pinned; else when its name is said, or one after another
